actions.name: Anchor Shot
actions.description: Effect: On hit, the user gains @Affliction[grapple], and the target gain @Affliction[grapple] and @Affliction[bound]. The user may remain at double their Reach to remain @Affliction[grapple] with the target. @Affliction[bound] may be removed with a Difficult Movement-related Skill, Lift, or Handiwork Skill Check taken as a Simple Action. If either @Affliction[grapple] or @Affliction[bound] are removed, the target loses the other Affliction.
